claims.statement: The H5 login routes live in ecshopx-espier while the login services live in ecshopx-members: espier's LoginController (class-level /api/v1/h5app) exposes POST /api/v1/h5app/wxapp/new_login, a @FrontNoAuth endpoint that merges query/body params via H5LoginRequestAssembler and delegates to FrontWxappNewLoginService, which delegates member resolution and token minting to members' H5LoginOrchestrator.

H5LoginOrchestrator.attempt resolves the user through EspierLocalUserResolver and then issues the JWT; the resolver selects an H5AuthStrategy from the auth_type via an EnumMap<H5AuthType, H5AuthStrategy> built from all Spring beans, so adding a login channel means adding an enum constant plus a @Component strategy without editing the resolver — covering LOCAL, WXAPP, OAUTH, WX_OFFIACCOUNT, PC_WXQRCODE, ALIAPP, SOCIAL_OAUTH and a default UNKNOWN that soft-fails.

The H5 JWT subject is an _espier_-joined composite: wechat login strategies build id as '<userId>_espier_<open_id>_espier_<unionid>', Alipay as '<userId>_espier_alipay_espier_<alipay_user_id>', and the local/bind paths build '<user_id>_espier_companyid_espier_<company_id>' (MemberAccountService.getTokenData); H5JwtUserLoginInfoEnrichService parses this composite back on every authenticated request.

H5JwtIssuer issues HS256 Nimbus JWTs from ecshopx.h5.jwt.* properties (secret-base64 ${JWT_SECRET}, ttl-minutes ${JWT_TTL:120}, refresh-ttl-minutes ${JWT_REFRESH_TTL:20160}, blacklist-grace-period-seconds ${JWT_BLACKLIST_GRACE_PERIOD:0}): it sets iss/sub/jti/iat/nbf/exp and copies every non-null user attribute as a custom claim except the reserved names iss,sub,aud,exp,nbf,iat,jti; H5JwtProperties fails fast on a required-claims list missing any of the six registered claims.

H5BearerJwtClaimsService.verifyAndExtractClaims is the single verification gate for @FrontAuth endpoints — it rejects a missing/non-Bearer header, a blacklisted token, an empty secret, a non-HS256 alg, a bad MACVerifier signature, a wrong iss, time-claim failure (with leeway), a missing required claim and a non-positive company_id, returning Optional.empty() rather than throwing so espier's FrontAuthInterceptor decides the HTTP shape (Dingo 401 code 401001, or Dingo 403 code 403001 for a truthy disabled claim).

H5JwtUserLoginInfoEnrichService.enrichClaims re-reads member and wechat state on every request (mirroring PHP EspierLocalUserProvider::getUserLoginInfo) and overwrites/fills user_id, company_id, disabled, open_id, unionid, nickname, headimgurl, grade_id, mobile, username and more — making the enrich service, not the JWT, the source of truth for member state, so a disabled member is rejected on the very next request even mid-token-TTL.

Token refresh blacklists the old token before minting a new one: H5JwtIssuer.refreshAccessToken verifies alg/iss/required registered claims, requires iat within refresh-ttl-minutes, then calls H5JwtBlacklistPort.addToBlacklist(compactJwt, exp) and re-issues from the surviving custom claims; the espier H5JwtBlacklistService implementation stores h5_jwt_invalidate:<sha256(compactJwt)> in the prism Redis DB (DB 2) with value now+blacklistGracePeriodSeconds and TTL tied to the token's exp, so the grace period is the window where a just-invalidated token is still accepted.

FrontNoAuthInterceptor serves @FrontNoAuth handlers by trying the same Bearer-JWT path first and otherwise building anonymous claims (user_id=0, api_from=h5app, wxapp_appid/woa_appid/alipay_appid resolved by appid shape) with company_id resolved in PHP FrontNoAuthMiddleWare priority: appid lookup → fixed system company (non-SaaS / main-tenant) → company_id query → Origin-domain lookup → UnauthorizedException, with MembersController.getNoAuthDecryptPhoneNumber as the single H5_COMPANY_ID=0 carve-out.

The CreateMemberSuccess event is the canonical AFTER_COMMIT dispatch: members publishes event:members:create_member_success through the one-method MembersCreateMemberSuccessDispatchPublisher port from ecshopx-common, implemented in bootstrap as ASYNC/REDIS/default-queue/RetryPolicy.platformDefault(), and every MemberAccountService registration path registers a TransactionSynchronization afterCommit while throwing BadRequestException up front when transaction synchronization is not active — guaranteeing the event is only published for rows that actually committed.

The CreateMemberSuccess payload contract is stable across all registration paths — company_id, user_id, mobile, openid, wxa_appid, inviter_id, distributor_id, source_id, monitor_id, salesperson_id, if_register_promotion — where if_register_promotion is forced false when the tenant's member_logout_config.new_rights is off and a members_delete_record row exists for that mobile (a deregistered member does not regain new-member rights).

Bootstrap registers nine dispatch listeners on create_member_success, each in its own registration config: youshu member sync, shuyun open-platform member.register, third-party Shopex CRM add-member (gated on crm.crm-sync), promotions register-promotion (gated on if_register_promotion), promotions register-point (gated on Redis register-point config), datacube register-num stats (slow queue), members' own create-member-success notice (slow queue, needs openid+wxa_appid), promotions send-membercard (gated on if_register_promotion), and — new this window — members' own create_member_success_new_customer listener feeding NewCustomerTagReconcileService (default queue, needs positive company_id+user_id).

Each MemberAccountService registration path (createMemberForWxappBind, createMemberLocalAutoRegister, registerShuyunMember, creatMemberForH5Post) also adds the userId to the daily active Redis set Member:<companyId>:<yyyyMMdd> in its afterCommit, and createMemberLocalAutoRegister enqueues a BindSalseperson job when work_userid and channel=1 — or the DM-CRM variant enqueueBindSalsepersonAfterDmMemberCreate when DmCrmSettingReadPort.isPointIntegrationOpen(companyId).

H5WxappPreLoginService.wxappPreLogin is where the wxapp new-login path actually creates the member: after code2session + phone-number decryption it routes to H5WxappLoginRegisterFacade.registerMemberForWxapp when no member exists for the mobile or an existing member lacks a matching wechat association, with the OEM-Shuyun mismatched-unionid case failing with ResourceException; the facade holds the registration policy (whitelist check, employee-auth or invite-code with Redis lock, OEM-Shuyun short-circuits, createMemberLocalAutoRegister plus fan/tag recording).

H5WxappLoginRegisterFacade treats employee-auth and invite-code as optional ObjectProvider-injected extensions (H5WxappRegisterEmployeeAuthenticator / H5WxappRegisterInviteBinder): startup succeeds without the implementing bundles, but a request asking for the feature when the bean is missing fails with ResourceException.

members.mobile is written through LegacyFixedMobileEncrypt.fixedEncryptMobile, a deterministic legacy-PHP-compatible AES (default AES-128-CBC, fixed IV) transform configured from ecshopx.compat-crypto.app-key/cipher and common.encrypt-sensitive-data; when common.encrypt-sensitive-data is false (the repo default) the transform is the identity, and the plaintext is kept alongside in members.region_mobile — so mobile lookups must always go through the encryptor to remain equality-queryable in both modes.

WxappMemberMobileChangeService.updateMemberMobile enforces a per-member 30-day cooldown via the Redis key updateMemberMobileCD:<userId>:<sha1(companyId)> (members.update-mobile.ttl-seconds default 2592000), verifies the SMS code stored under member-update:company<companyId>:<newMobile>, rejects duplicate mobiles within the tenant, updates mobile/region_mobile/mobile_country_code, writes a member_operate_log row with old/new JSON, and only then sets the cooldown key.

MemberSmsVerificationCodeDeliveryService.deliver enforces the daily SMS cap via the yzmsend:<companyId>:<yyyyMMdd>:<type>:<mobile> counter (common.sms-send-limit, default 5, 24h expiry), stores a 6-digit code for 300 seconds under member-<type>:company<companyId>:<mobile> on the members Redis template, and sends through CompanySmsSendPort.sendVerificationCodeForScene(..., verification_code), failing with ResourceException on send failure.

WechatFansSyncService.syncWechatFans throttles official-account fan sync to 3 runs per day and one per 10 minutes per company via the syncUsersCount<yyyyMMdd>:<sha1(companyId)> Redis list (expiry at end of day), then pages the official-account user/get API 10,000 openids at a time and publishes one event:members:sync_wechat_fans message per page, consumed on the slow queue by SyncWechatFansPageNotificationProcessor in batches of ≤100.

Overseas trust login (auth_type=social_oauth, providers apple/google/facebook/line per SocialTrustLoginTypes) maps an existing members_associations row to the member, or allocates a unique synthetic mobile (MemberSyntheticMobileService: '10' + 9 random digits, unique per company, bounded attempts) and creates the member through creatMemberForH5Post with auth_type=social_oauth, so the social path joins the CreateMemberSuccess fan-out.

Apple trust login needs a server-side callback controller at /api/v1/h5app/wxapp/trustlogin/apple/callback (GET and POST, deliberately without @FrontNoAuth) because Apple posts the authorization code as a form: it resolves the h5 host only from the one-time Redis-bound state (the h5_host query param is ignored and the binding is GETDEL-consumed and must equal common.h5-base-url, else the callback 500s), then 302-redirects to the H5 landing URL with the normalized code (or the error/error_description pair). SocialTrustLoginService carries the state↔h5Host bookkeeping (600 s under ecx:apple_oauth:h5:<md5(state)>), the ES256 client-secret signing (180-day exp) and RS256 id_token verification against Apple's JWKS with issuer/audience checks.

MemberAccountService.createWxappFans is the shared upsert behind login-time fan recording: insert-or-update the wechat_users row keyed by (company_id, authorizer_appid, open_id, unionid) and, when a bind_member_user_id was supplied and no wechat association exists, insert the members_associations row, returning is_new = 'no association', which the official-account login strategy uses to decide whether the fan still needs to register; updateWechatUnionId migrates a stale unionid across both tables and clears need_transfer.

PUT /api/v1/h5app/wxapp/member flows through WxappMemberUpdateMemberService: Shuyun open-platform member.modify before the local write, MemberAccountService.memberInfoUpdate, then an after-commit event:members:update_member_success publish with a fresh members_info snapshot — an event whose only bootstrap listener is the Shopex CRM update-member sync, gated on crm.crm-sync.

The MemberAccountService*DispatchTest family (using MemberAccountServiceDispatchIntegrationTestConfiguration with mocked mappers/publishers and a real PlatformTransactionManager) pins which side effects fire per registration path, and H5NewLoginPathsCreateMemberSuccessDispatchProbeTest verifies end-to-end from the real login entries that the CreateMemberSuccess payload is published on commit and NOT published after setRollbackOnly().

The goods-arrival (缺货订阅) subscribe subsystem is owned by ecshopx-members: the `members_subscribe_notice` table (domain `SubscribeNotice`, `SubscribeNoticeMapper`), the wxapp subscribe/status endpoints in `MembersController`, and the wechat leg of the notify fan-out; the Alipay leg (source=alipay) is implemented in ecshopx-ali's `ItemStoreGoodsArrivalAliTemplateOrchestrator` driven by the ali listener.

`SubscribeNotice` rows are one subscription per (company_id, user_id, rel_id=item_id, source, distributor_id) with sub_type='goods' and a sub_status lifecycle NO→SUCCESS; the schema documents an ERROR state and err_reason column but no Java code path ever writes them, and unsubscribe deletes the row rather than archiving it.

`POST /api/v1/h5app/wxapp/member/subscribe/item/{item_id}` (缺货订阅) is a toggle: an existing matching row with sub_status=NO is deleted (unsubscribe), otherwise the item must exist (MembersSubscribeNoticeItemNamePort.itemExists, else ResourceException("商品不存在")) and a new row is inserted; the recipient open_id and source (wechat via open_id/wxapp_appid claims, alipay via alipay_user_id) come from the caller's enriched claims.

The `arrivalNoticeSub` Redis hash on the shared template is the subscribe/notify contract: the toggle writes/deletes field userId with JSON {open_id, wxa_appid} under key `arrivalNoticeSub:<companyId>:<itemId>[:<distributorId>]` for wechat (a source segment is prepended for alipay, per GoodsArrivalNoticeSubscribeRedisKeys.hashKey); it has no expiry, is read by `GET /wxapp/member/item/is_subscribe/{item_id}` (rather than the table) and by the wechat notify leg's per-row appid lookup (the alipay leg never reads it), and is now also cleared per matched row by GoodsArrivalSubscribeMatchService.markSuccess via clearArrivalNoticeSubscribeRedis — so the mini-program stops showing 已订阅到货通知 after a restock consume, and a Redis flush desynchronizes hash and table until the next toggle or notify.

The goods bundle publishes `event:258:GoodsBundle\Events\ItemStoreUpdateEvent` (GoodsDispatchEventNames.EVENT_ITEM_STORE_UPDATE) with payload {item_id, store, distributor_id} in SYNC mode via DispatchOptions.eventDefaults() from ItemStoreService.saveItemStore/saveItemStoreForWdtSync through the bootstrap ItemStoreUpdatedEventBusPublisherImpl, so all registered listeners run inline in the publisher's thread and transaction; bootstrap registers the members listener as `listener:members.listeners.ItemStoreUpdatedGoodsArrival` (syncDefaults, in ItemStoreUpdatedEventDispatchListenerRegistrationConfig alongside the ali `goods.listeners.SendTemplateMsgListener` registered first) and the Shuyun product-sync listener separately.

ItemStoreUpdatedGoodsArrivalDispatchListener.onEvent returns immediately when the event's store is zero or negative, so out-of-stock transitions never notify; for a positive store it first dispatches the wechat send through ItemStoreGoodsArrivalWxaTemplateOrchestrator.dispatchIfApplicable, then independently resolves the company via ItemCompanyIdResolver and calls GoodsArrivalSubscribeMatchService.markSuccess with the normalized distributor id — the listener itself has no try/catch, so only the send leg is failure-tolerant while a throwing markSuccess would fail the publisher's SYNC transaction.

ItemStoreGoodsArrivalWxaTemplateOrchestrator (PHP SendTemplateMsgListener wechat-branch parity) is fully best-effort: dispatchIfApplicable wraps everything in try/catch(RuntimeException) logging at debug, re-checks store>0 and itemId>0, resolves the company, matches pending rows via listPending(companyId, itemId, dist, "wechat"), builds data fields {item_name (multi-language name truncated to 20 code points via MembersSubscribeNoticeItemNamePort), notice = 亲！您想要的商品已经到货，可以购买啦！}, and per row with an open_id sends {scenes_name: "goodsArrivalNotice", company_id, appid, openid, data, page_query_str: "id="+itemId} through the common GoodsArrivalWxaSubscribeSendPort with forceFire=true (never delayed by send_time_desc).

Per subscriber row the wechat appid is resolved from the row's own shop-scoped key `arrivalNoticeSub:<companyId>:<itemId>[:<rowDistributorId>]` (hash field userId, JSON value's wxa_appid — the appid the member was on when subscribing); on a hash miss or null user id it falls back to the wechat_weapp authorizer appid for template name yykweishop (WeappAuthorizerAppidRepository.findAuthorizerAppid), and an empty appid skips that row's send.

GoodsArrivalSubscribeMatchService's matching rule is distributor-scope based: a shop stock event (eventDistributorId>0) matches only rows with exactly that distributor_id (the total-store port is not consulted), while a headquarters event (eventDistributorId==0) additionally matches shop-scoped rows only when that shop currently draws the SKU from headquarters stock, decided by DistributorItemTotalStorePort.filterDistributorIdsUsingTotalStore (goods' impl over distributor_items.is_total_store) — a shop keeping local stock is not notified by a platform restock.

The wechat send is matched with source=wechat (listPending) while the subsequent markSuccess is source-agnostic and is the only writer of SUCCESS on the event:258 path — the alipay leg sends via its own source=alipay listPending but never marks. markSuccess additionally clears each matched row's arrivalNoticeSub hash field on the shared Redis template after the UPDATE. The consequence is that rows can be marked SUCCESS (and their Redis markers cleared) without their individual send firing (missing appid, missing open_id, or the orchestrator swallowing a runtime error), so both legs must keep the same matching semantics or a row can be silently marked without a send.

The goods-arrival notify path has no retry, no ERROR/err_reason write and no Redis dedupe lock: a failed send still marks the row SUCCESS and clears its arrivalNoticeSub hash field (the subscriber gets no second chance until re-subscribing), and a repeat event:258 for the same item is naturally a no-op because the marking UPDATE re-guards sub_status='NO' inside the statement, preventing double-marks under concurrency.

The send port `GoodsArrivalWxaSubscribeSendPort` (declared in ecshopx-common/port/members so members never depends on promotions) is implemented in promotions by GoodsArrivalWxaSubscribeSendAdapter, delegating to the central WXA subscribe sender WxaTemplateMsgActivityRemindSendService; the goodsArrivalNotice scene is WxaTemplateSceneDefinitions.GOODS_ARRIVAL_NOTICE (template id 5019, 商品到货通知, keywords item_name/notice).

The admin console reads subscribe notices read-only via `GET /api/v1/members/subscribe/list` (MembersSubscribeController, @AdminAuth + @Activated routeAlias member.subscribe.list) over MembersSubscribeNoticeListService, filtering by sub_type (default goods), sub_status, rel_id and created-time range, joining the member username per row (匿名 fallback) and re-resolving item names for goods rows.

The goods-arrival subsystem behavior is pinned by GoodsArrivalSubscribeMatchServiceTest (shop event = exact distributor_id with the total-store port never consulted; headquarters event = distributor_id=0 row plus only is_total_store=true shops), ItemStoreGoodsArrivalWxaTemplateOrchestratorTest (store<=0 skips everything; send payload carries scenes_name=goodsArrivalNotice, resolved appid, openid and page_query_str id=<itemId> with forceFire=true; a headquarters event reads the appid from the row's own arrivalNoticeSub:<companyId>:<itemId>:<rowDistributorId> key), and bootstrap's ItemStoreUpdatedAliTemplateBusDispatchFlowTest (event:258 runs the ali listener before the members listener inline, then the ali template job is enqueued).

Flyway migration V00000000000006 adds the member system-tag schema: members_tags gains tag_code + tag_kind (manual|system, default manual) + rule_version with the unique key uk_company_tag_code (company_id, tag_code) enforcing one tag per code per tenant; members_rel_tags gains source/rule_version/effective_at/updated_at; a new members_rel_tags_audit table records one row per attach|detach with source/rule_version/reason/event_id keyed idx_company_user_tag; and promotions_marketing_activity/promotions_seckill_activity gain the member_tag_ids JSON + member_tag_mode (include|exclude) audience columns.

MemberSystemTagCodes is the single vocabulary of the system-tag subsystem: the reserved codes new_customer (新客, no effective paid order), birthday_this_month (当月生日, birth month equals the current calendar month) and sleeping_user (沉睡用户, last completed order strictly more than SLEEPING_THRESHOLD_SECONDS = 180*86400 seconds ago — exactly 180 days does not match), plus RULE_VERSION=1, the SOURCE_* provenance strings (register, pay, refund, cancel, bind, disable, enable, compensate, daily) and the audit actions attach/detach; isReservedCode drives the write guard's create rejection.

MemberSystemTagSeedService.seedCompany idempotently inserts the three system tags (tag_kind=system, distributor_id=0, tag_code set) keyed by (company_id, tag_code); it is triggered by MemberSystemTagHistoricalSeedRunner (ApplicationRunner @Order(200) sweeping all tenants at boot), by CompanyActivatedSystemTagListener (@TransactionalEventListener AFTER_COMMIT fallbackExecution=true on CompanyActivatedEvent in REQUIRES_NEW) for new tenants, and lazily by each reconcile service when its tag lookup misses, so a tenant that lost a system-tag row self-heals on the next event.

All three reconcile services share one pattern — compute the desired membership from a rule query, diff against the existing members_rel_tags row, and write exactly one members_rel_tags_audit row per actual change stamped with the triggering SOURCE_* and RULE_VERSION; attaches catch DuplicateKeyException (idempotent under concurrent events), detaches delete the rel row by id, and nothing is written when the desired state already holds.

NewCustomerTagReconcileService.reconcile (blank source falls back to compensate) detaches ALL of the member's system tags when the source is disable, the member is missing, or disabled=true; otherwise NewCustomerEffectivePaidOrderQuery.countEffectivePaid (JdbcTemplate over orders_normal_orders) defines an effective paid order as pay_status='PAYED' and cancel_status<>'SUCCESS' and (total_fee=0 or total_fee greater than the sum of its SUCCESS refunds in aftersales_refund), attaching the 新客 rel when the count is 0 and detaching the existing rel when it is positive.

BirthdayThisMonthReconcileService runs only on the first day of the month (executeMonthly skips otherwise), is driven by the XXL-Job cron handler member-system-tag-birthday-this-month (ScheduleBirthdayThisMonthTagHandler, which publishes a CronAlertEvent and rethrows on failure, with per-company failures aggregated into one IllegalStateException at the end), and per company attaches/detaches so the tag set equals non-disabled members whose birth month — members_info.month when valid, else parsed from the birthday string (ISO date, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', or first 10 chars) — equals the current month, auditing with source=compensate and reason=birthday_this_month.

SleepingUserTagReconcileService is driven daily from the orders bundle's FinishOrderJobService (the finish-orders job runs it after the batch and never fails the job on its RuntimeException): per company it pages SleepingUserLastCompletedOrderQuery.listUserIdsLastCompletedBefore (users whose MAX(end_time) over DONE orders is older than now-180d, page size 200) and additionally re-reconciles every current tag holder so both directions settle; a member with no completed order is never sleeping, and a missing/disabled member is detached.

Four triggers feed NewCustomerTagReconcileService: CreateMemberSuccessNewCustomerDispatchListener on event:members:create_member_success (SOURCE_REGISTER), NormalOrderPaySuccessNewCustomerDispatchListener on event:288:OrdersBundle\Events\NormalOrderPaySuccessEvent (SOURCE_PAY) and NormalOrderCancelNewCustomerDispatchListener on event:orders:normal_order_cancel (SOURCE_CANCEL) — all three dispatch listeners registered in bootstrap on the default queue, the two order listeners resolving user_id from order_id via NewCustomerEffectivePaidOrderQuery.findUserIdByOrder when the payload's user_id is not positive and returning silently otherwise — plus the Spring TradeRefundNewCustomerListener on TradeRefundSpringEvent in REQUIRES_NEW, gated on refund_status=SUCCESS (SOURCE_REFUND).

MemberSystemTagWriteGuard throws ResourceException(系统标签不可编辑) from rejectWrite (updating a tag_kind=system row), rejectCreatePayload (creating with tag_kind/type=system or one of the reserved codes) and rejectTagId(s) (attaching/detaching a system tag by id), and is enforced by the admin tag services (MemberTagsCreateService/MemberTagsUpdateService), the rel-tag writer MemberRelTagsBatchCreateService and the openapi tag batch/cover/update/delete services — so the reconcile services are the only writers of system-tag relations on any surface; on the read side MemberSystemTagQueryScope keeps system tags visible beside distributor-scoped manual tags in MemberTagsListService list/detail queries.

MemberAudienceTagValidator.assertUsable is the read-side gate for the new promotions audience columns (used by promotions' MarketingActivityCreatePersistenceService and SeckillActivityCreateService): every referenced member_tag_id must exist in the tenant, and a manual tag must belong to the activity's distributor_id, while system tags are usable from any distributor.

The front MembersController address surface is hardened against cross-member access (ECX-10913/ECX-10923, PHP MembersOwnerScopeGuard parity): POST /wxapp/member/address resolves the acting user through resolveEffectiveUserIdForCreate, which only consults buy_user_id when a truthy promoter_user_id loosely equals the authenticated user, rejects a positive buy_user_id different from the caller with ResourceException(无权访问该数据), and otherwise falls through to authUserId; GET /wxapp/member/addresslist applies the same rule via resolveFilterUserIdForAddressList and always returns authUserId, removing the old null filterUserId orphan-address bypass — the four create branches are pinned by MembersControllerAddressBuyUserScopeTest.

The system-tag subsystem is pinned by unit tests in ecshopx-members/src/test/.../service/systemtag/: NewCustomerTagReconcileServiceTest (zero effective paid attaches once with the caller's SOURCE in the audit row, a paid order detaches, disable/missing/disabled detaches all system tags), SleepingUserTagReconcileServiceTest (180-day strict threshold and sweep diffs), BirthdayThisMonthReconcileServiceTest, MemberSystemTagWriteGuardTest and MemberSystemTagSeedServiceTest, plus TradeRefundNewCustomerListenerTest for the refund SUCCESS gate.

MemberAccountService.createMemberLocalAutoRegister, on the new-member branch, resolves inviter_id/source_id/monitor_id/latest_source_id/latest_monitor_id from the request extras (persisting each on the members row only when positive), then runs the promoter/distribution side-effect pipeline in-transaction — AdminMemberCreatePromoterSideEffectPort.createForNewMember(companyId, userId, mobilePlain, gradeId), AdminMemberCreateDistributorUserSideEffectPort.createData(companyId, userId, distributorId, salespersonId, inviterId), and insertShopRelMemberIfAbsent when distributor_id > 0 — before building the create-member-success eventData (including if_register_promotion) and registering the after-commit synchronization guarded by BadRequestException("createMemberLocalAutoRegister requires active transaction synchronization"); the existing-member branch skips this pipeline entirely (update-only, is_new=0/1 for upload members, no publish).

MemberAccountServiceCreateMemberLocalAutoRegisterDispatchTest pins the extended auto-register flow: the promoter and distributor side-effect ports are invoked with the resolved inviter/distributor/salesperson ids, ShopRelMember is inserted when distributor_id>0, the published CreateMemberSuccess payload carries the extras' openid/wxa_appid/source_id/monitor_id/inviter_id, the work_userid+channel=1 bind-salesperson enqueue variants fire (standard vs DM-open), and setRollbackOnly() suppresses both the publish and the enqueues.
